source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "data governance" AND (city OR cities OR municipal OR urban)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"data governance" AND (city OR cities OR municipal OR urban),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("data governance" AND ("cities" OR "city" OR "municipal" OR "urban"))
